name: Compute Cluster S30: Profit Factor & Expected Value
description: Tests: profit factor = sum(wins) / abs(sum(losses)), expected value = (win_rate * avg_win) - (loss_rate * avg_loss). Separates winning and losing returns correctly.
source:
# =============================================================================
# COMPUTE CLUSTER S30: Profit Factor & Expected Value
# =============================================================================
# S30 rules:
#   Profit Factor = sum(winning trades) / abs(sum(losing trades))
#     > 1.0 = profitable, > 2.0 = strong
#   Expected Value = (win_rate * avg_win) - (loss_rate * avg_loss)
#     > 0 = edge exists
#   Don't default to avg win / avg loss — outliers distort.

src = study_assets()
close = src.c
rets = returns(close)

# === Separate wins and losses ===
winning_ret = where(rets > 0, rets)
losing_ret = where(rets < 0, rets)

# === Dense win/loss flags for rate calculation (S29 pattern) ===
win_flag = conditional_select(rets > 0, 1.0, 0.0)
loss_flag = conditional_select(rets < 0, 1.0, 0.0)

# === Cumulative sums for profit factor ===
cum_wins = agg(winning_ret, AggregationType.Sum)
cum_losses = agg(losing_ret, AggregationType.Sum)

# === Rolling average win/loss ===
avg_win_20 = sma(where(rets > 0, rets), 20)
avg_loss_20 = sma(where(rets < 0, abs(rets)), 20)

# === Rolling win rate ===
rolling_wr = sma(win_flag, 60)

# === REPORTERS ===
xy_lines(
    title='Cumulative Winning vs Losing Returns',
    category='Profit Factor',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Cum Wins', color=Color.Green),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Cum Losses', color=Color.Red)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[ReferenceLine(value=0, title='Zero')])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(cum_wins, cum_losses))

xy_lines(
    title='Rolling Avg Win vs Avg Loss (20d)',
    category='Profit Factor',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Avg Win', color=Color.Green),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Avg Loss', color=Color.Red)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(avg_win_20, avg_loss_20))

xy_lines(
    title='Rolling Win Rate (60d)',
    category='Expected Value',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Win Rate', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.5, title='50%', color=Color.White, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=rolling_wr)

summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.standard,
    category='Profit Factor Summary',
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
      title='Profit Factor Components',
      row_size=2, col_size=2,
      row_headers=['Winning', 'Losing'],
      col_headers=['Sum', 'Mean'],
      cells=[
        ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum,
                   type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean,
                   type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
        ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum,
                   type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean,
                   type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3)
      ]))
(winning_ret, winning_ret, losing_ret, losing_ret)
